description: Powerful ORM built on top of HoloNET Client for Holochain. Enables rapid hApp development via HoloNETEntryBase, HoloNETAuditEntryBase, HoloNETCollection and HoloNETObservableCollection — call Load, Save, Delete with automatic change tracking and rollback. Upgraded to Holochain 0.7.0. Lightweight version: use NextGenSoftware.Holochain.HoloNET.ORM.Embedded if you want the conductor auto-started.
releaseNotes:
## v4.1.0 — Holochain 0.7.0 Wire Protocol Upgrade

Tracks HoloNET Client v4.1.0: full Holochain 0.7.0 wire-protocol support.
- Kitsune2/iroh (QUIC) as sole network backend (tx5/WebRTC removed).
- New paginated DumpOpTimings API on both Admin and App interfaces.
- AwaitingMemproofs app status, updated DnaStorageInfo shape.
- DesensitizedZomeCallCapGrant and CapAccessInfo typed for response-side cap grants.
- TestHarness paths configurable via HOLONET_* environment variables.

*Full Changelog:* https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

---

## v4.0.0 — Holochain 0.6.2 Upgrade + OASIS Omniverse Reboot (2026)

The biggest HoloNET release since the original launch — full Holochain 0.6.2 compatibility plus the complete OASIS Omniverse relaunch at https://holonet.oasisomniverse.one

### Holochain 0.6.2 Upgrade
- Full compatibility with Holochain 0.6.2, the Kitsune2 networking stack, and updated conductor APIs
- Upgraded GrantedFunctions wire format (string-keyed dictionary: "All"/"Listed" variants replacing old enum keys)
- ORM.Embedded variant now correctly bundles Holochain 0.6.2 binaries (hc.exe + holochain.exe)
- Embedded/non-embedded package split fully automated in the build pipeline

### HoloNET ORM v4.0.0 Highlights
- HoloNETEntryBase and HoloNETAuditEntryBase: base classes for mapping .NET models directly to Rust hApp DHT entry structs — no boilerplate
- HoloNETCollection<T>: batch-load, save, and delete entire collections of DHT entries with a single method call
- HoloNETObservableCollection<T>: WPF/XAML-bindable ORM collection for reactive UI apps
- Full change tracking, version control, and one-method rollback on every entry
- CRUD methods (LoadAsync, SaveAsync, DeleteAsync) handle all Holochain conductor wire protocol details for you
- Converts any existing .NET class to a Holochain hApp entry with minimal code changes
- Works seamlessly with OASIS STAR ODK which can auto-generate the matching Rust zome code

### OASIS Omniverse Reboot
- Upgraded to .NET 10 for maximum performance and longevity
- Copyright updated: NextGen Software Ltd 2019 - 2026
- Part of the unified OASIS Omniverse ecosystem at https://holonet.oasisomniverse.one
- Full README overhaul: HoloNETCollection, HoloNETObservableCollection, and all ORM classes fully documented with code examples and XAML WPF binding examples
- Improved error handling and async stability throughout
- Open source under MIT licence — https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp
